name: Replay a track that is part reconstructed, part recorded AIS
description: Validates the Yi Peng 3 case: the ship card says where reconstructed positions end and recorded AIS begins, the event list covers both days, and the recorded stretch is listed with its archive source.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /cases/yi-peng-3-2024 and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state ready
Assert the page heading reads "Yi Peng 3 anchor drag" and the ship card (data-testid ship-card) contains "Until 06:01 UTC positions are reconstructed from statements"
Assert the event list (data-testid event-list) heading reads "17 and 18 November, minute by minute"
In the event list, click the row "Slows from 7.6 knots to under 1 and holds position for 75 minutes"
Assert the replay clock (data-testid replay-clock) reads "08:24 UTC" and the line under it reads "18 Nov 2024, 09:24 in Stockholm"
Assert the placement card entry with data-testid recorded-track-entry contains "Recorded AIS to 10:59, 114 positions"
Assert the sources list (data-testid source-list) contains a link titled "AIS data archive, aisdk-2024-11-18.zip" from the Danish Maritime Authority
